text:
Iris Feldman: :loudspeaker: New internal process for customer data requests (subpoenas, legal holds) affecting Private/VPC/on-prem deployments. Summary + immediate action items below.

Asha Patel: Why the change? Any recent incidents prompting this?

Iris Feldman: Clarifying flow + SLAs after a recent customer request exposed gaps between Support, Security, and Legal handoffs. New central intake, triage timelines, and per-customer runbooks.

Jordan Lee: TL;DR on impact to customers? Will they need to change configs?

Iris Feldman: No config change required for most. Changes are internal: a required runbook per on-prem install that lists data locations, retention, and contact points. Customers with air-gapped setups may need to provide access artifacts per the runbook.

Marco Ruiz: Ops note: added a `redwoodctl onprem collect-evidence --cluster CLUSTER_ID --case CASE_ID` command for automated, signed evidence bundles. Output bundle is PGP-signed and includes checksums.

Asha Patel: Compliance: new SLA targets: initial triage by Legal within 24h, evidence bundle ready within 72h for hosted/Dedicated, and 5 business days for air-gapped HSM environments (due to manual steps). Exceptions require exec sign-off.

Legal Bot: Legal checklist published: https://docs.internal.redwood/legal/data-request-process (internal). Must be followed for every production request. Also included template for customer-facing notification.

Jordan Lee: CS action: prepare a short customer note explaining how we handle requests and what to expect for on-prem. Include contact points and the assisted-evidence SKU for air-gapped sites. Ill draft.

Iris Feldman: Security/Privacy note: bundles exclude secrets and private keys. For HSM customers, we provide signed metadata and coordinate with customer HSM ops for any key-related evidence. Appendix covers HSM-specific steps.

Marco Ruiz: Sample command & expected output:
```
redwoodctl onprem collect-evidence --cluster cl-123 --case 2026-0009
# creates: evidence-2026-0009.tar.gz
# signature: evidence-2026-0009.sig (PGP)
# manifest: evidence-2026-0009.json
```

Support Bot: New ticket tag `data-request` available. Route all customer asks through Support -> Legal intake. Automated reminder set at 24h + 72h.

Asha Patel: Action list:
- Legal: finalize templates & SLAs (Asha)
- Eng: ship `collect-evidence` + signed bundles (Marco)
- CS: customer-facing FAQ + assisted SKU (Jordan)
- Ops: onboard runbooks to SRE playbooks (Marco)

Jordan Lee: Draft customer FAQ link: https://docs.internal.redwood/cs/faq/data-requests-onprem. Will ping Legal for sign-off.

Iris Feldman: Enforcement: process effective immediately for all new requests. Please follow the Legal checklist for any live requests. If you see edge cases, escalate to #incidents and tag Legal. Closing announcement, will post a short exec summary once templates are finalized. :white_check_mark:
